mentions.name: ClassTable
mentions.description: Full school management software designed to be easy to use for school staff, students, and parents, with a focus on letting parents keep an eye on their children's progress.
mentions.problem: Built out of frustration with existing school information management software, experienced as a father of five.
mentions.source_excerpt: And second thing im building is out of sheer frustration as a father of 5 in the school info management - https://www.classtable.org - aims to be a full school management software which is easy to use for both school staff, students AND (personal itch) for parents to keep an eye on their childrens progress
mentions.author: wingtw
